## Requirements (contract)

1. Publish exactly the accepted candidate atomically in the bounded/staging
   namespace: the exact `p-17b713…` artifact set, pinned artifact digests,
   the latest-pointer transition recorded, intake unadvertised and
   `operational=false`.
2. Verify the artifact set over unauthenticated reads: compartments,
   records, search, tiles, citations, withdrawal behavior, disclosure text,
   withheld/suppressed records and edges, old citations preserving bytes or
   truthful tombstones, no partial release observable, intake verified only
   as honestly unavailable (no synthetic submissions — none are authorized).
3. Exercise rollback: prior-release rollback in staging (atomic pointer
   restore), the no-prior-pointer path the ROLLBACK_PACKET names, and the
   refusal path (a failed deployment leaves the previous release); record
   live rollback instructions and the residual production obligations.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] unauthenticated public reads match approved digests across
      compartments and citations — `V.digests` (all 18 manifest artifacts
      re-hashed over the served tree) + `V.http_reads` (23 unauthenticated
      GETs on a plain static server, every route 200 with approved bytes) +
      `V.citations` (`/r/<pub>` cite-this-URL marking, compat-index redirect,
      bare-selector answer, honest pre-release `unavailable`);
- [x] no partial release observable — `P.validate_first` +
      `P.pointer_transition` (validate-first, pointer-last, `null →
      p-17b713…` recorded) + `P.staged_revalidates` (post-publish whole-tree
      re-validation, state=complete) + `R.refused_deploy` (a tampered bundle
      leaves pointer/catalog/served bytes byte-identical);
- [x] withheld records/edges remain suppressed — `V.suppressed_slices` (the
      3 spine-level dispositions loudly recorded in `exclusions.json` +
      DISCLOSURE; the 0-record surface leaks nothing) + `V.withdrawal_barrier`
      + the exercised deny path in `R.prior_release` (inter-activation
      withdrawals keep denying under rollback — artifact tombstone + entity
      deny);
- [x] old citations preserve bytes or truthful tombstones —
      `R.prior_release` (the candidate's non-denied bytes serve
      byte-identically at immutable routes after rollback) +
      `R.no_prior_pointer` (immutable routes keep serving identical bytes
      with the pointer honestly absent);
- [x] receiver unavailability has honest public state —
      `V.intake_unavailable` (`[intake].operational=false`, env gate unset,
      `/intake/new` + POST `/intake/v1/reports` → 503
      `receiver_not_operating`, no published byte advertises submission; no
      synthetic report — none are authorized);
- [x] prior release remains/reverts atomically if deployment fails —
      `R.prior_release` (atomic pointer restore to the labelled stand-in
      prior) + `R.refused_deploy` (validate_release refuses before staging);
- [x] verification green; requirement id stamped in PR — verdict=pass, 25/25
      checks; SIG-TRUST-009 stamped in the PR body and `COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv`
      (MET);
- [x] non-automatically-verifiable work has an owned DEFERRALS row —
      `D-R10-PUBLISH-1` (production half), `D-P32.23a-1`, `D-R10-LIVE-1`,
      `D-P32.16-1` annotated and stay OPEN;
- [x] run ledger, BUILD_INDEX, control advancement updated; no merge/tag/
      push-main — this file, `BUILD_INDEX.md` row 191, `LEDGER.md` CURRENT
      STATE + PHASE LOG, `docs/build/pr/P32.25.md`; stacked branch only.

## Plan

1. Preflight (PF.*): refuse anything that is not the signed subject —
   GATE-G3 readout must exist and name the exact publication/identity/
   snapshot; `CANDIDATE_MANIFEST` must equal every accepted pin; re-hash all
   18 manifest artifacts; `DISCLOSURE` + all three dossiers must carry the
   reduced-scope posture.
2. Publish (P.*): `activate()` into a **fresh** bounded staging registry —
   non-empty registries refused so the pointer transition is observable;
   validate-first, `latest.json` last; post-publish re-validation of the
   whole staged tree.
3. Verify (V.*): every manifest artifact digest over the served tree **and**
   over real unauthenticated HTTP GETs from a throwaway static server;
   citation/selector states; honest zero-record/search/tile states;
   withdrawal barrier; loudly-recorded suppressed slices; provisional
   disclosures; intake verified only as honestly unavailable; zero-JS.
4. Rollback (R.*): labelled scratch registries — stand-in prior release →
   candidate → `rollback(prior)`; the real no-prior-pointer path via the new
   additive `exports.release.clear_latest_pointer`; refused deploy of a
   tampered bundle.
5. Emit `PUBLISH_PROOF.json` + `PUBLIC_VERIFICATION.md` +
   `ROLLBACK_REHEARSAL.json` + `LIVE_RETURN_PASS.json`
   (`prepared_not_executed`) + the staging/rehearsal registries under the
   committed report dir.
6. Build memory: ADR-144 + ADR index + Appendix F row; DEFERRALS
   annotations (all stay OPEN); `SIG-TRUST-009` → MET; BL-058 sources;
   BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER/phase-log closeout.

## Deviations / honest notes

- The "prior release" in the rollback rehearsal is the committed P32.24
  **acceptance-corpus** release (`p-81f1986a…`, `sig.journey-corpus/1`) — a
  labelled stand-in for "whatever pointer production holds at rollback
  time". It is not a production predecessor of the candidate: the candidate
  is the first immutable release, so its real rollback path is the
  ROLLBACK_PACKET's no-prior-pointer branch (also rehearsed).
- `live_verification=false` — no production serve, hosted probe, gate tick,
  human label, intake operation, or synthetic submission is claimed. The
  production public exposure needs `D-R10-LIVE-1` / the operator's own
  return pass; recorded, never claimed.
